text.text_excerpt: The best fish tacos in town are Woody's! You can find Woody himself at the Freret, Harrison, Palmer Park, and Crescent City Farmers Markets and various other Fest gatherings and pop up spots around the city. He has quite a cult like following for those with a deep love of Fish tacos. The tacos are messy, hot, and grilled right in front of you from giant filets of freshly caught fish and then topped off with his special spicy remoulade sauce and fresh cabbage on corn tortillas.. extra super yum! The offerings usually include blackened fish tacos, grilled shrimp tacos and slow roasted pork tacos. He also does a black bean taco for the non meat eaters. If you haven't tried it yet you have to...

You would think that a shrimp or fish taco at a festival or arts market would be sketchy. You would be wrong. Woody's tacos are served at a variety of events around town. I've had them at both the Arts Market in Palmer Park and at the Freret Street festival. They are always delicious and fresh. He also serves a meat (pork today) and a vegetarian/vegan taco too. But I've never had those. Check out their FB page (http://www.facebook.com/pages/Woodys-Fish-Tacos/215165961864000) to see where they'll be next... After tomorrow that is since the Arts Market in November is Saturday & Sunday, you can still try them out this weekend.

Umm, hi, it's me your biggest fan! I LOVE Woody's Fish Tacos. The fish is awesome, the tortilla is perfect and the sauce and coleslaw on top is the perfect combination with a little Sirachi on top. I sometimes go to art markets just to find this stand!
